D5/S3/QuantumBounds/TsirelsonTightness.b.name: D5.S3.QuantumBounds.TsirelsonTightness.bell_chsh_state_expectation_is_greatest
D5/S3/QuantumBounds/TsirelsonTightness.b.signature: theorem bell_chsh_state_expectation_is_greatest : IsGreatest (Set.range fun state : { rho : CHSHWitness.TwoQubitMatrix // rho.PosSemidef ∧ Matrix.trace rho = 1 } => RCLike.re (Matrix.trace (state.1 * CHSHWitness.chshOperator))) (2 * Real.sqrt 2)
